# Upstream provenance

- Project: NeuralAmpModelerCore
- Source: https://github.com/sdatkinson/NeuralAmpModelerCore
- Base release: `v0.1.0`
- Base commit: `74a07ce222fac3e681e7c2c2cb515d53c4e272b4`
- License: MIT

The `NAM` sources match upstream `v0.1.0` after normalizing the original
checkout's CRLF line endings. The `wrapper` directory and vendored `json.hpp`
are the legacy Pedalboard3/NAM integration snapshot that was already used by
the application before this directory was made reproducible in Git.
